title: Banned

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Hello,

I am the mod which banned you. Now as you claim above, we banned you without screen sharing you, well, we prefer to user screen sharing as a last resort, we don't screen share ALL our players before banning them. 

I have sufficient evidence for for the ban here: http://youtu.be/dbgOKMZEGnI
As you claimed in TeamSpeak previously, you were purposefully acting suspicious to get screen shared, I still don't understand why you wanted to that or if it is true or not.

Regards,
Cammy G Avicus Moderator

Hello,

We've decided to accept your appeal, since the evidence is indeed insufficient, and inconclusive; thus, your infraction for aimbot will indeed be removed. Senior Staff
